_comment: Passed via `claude --settings <this-file>` by scripts/launch-topic.sh when the proxy spawns a topic session. Enables telegram@zamua JUST for that session (the global settings.json keeps its own telegram disabled so no other claude spawns a competing getUpdates poller). The permissions.allow of the 4 channel tools is redundant under --permission-mode auto (which auto-approves routine calls) but harmless. NB: AskUserQuestion is removed via the launcher's --disallowedTools= CLI flag, NOT a settings key here - the disallowedTools SETTINGS key is not honored for it (verified live: the model still rendered the tool); only the CLI flag (= form) removes it.
_comment_hook: The Stop hook keeps replies out of the transcript: if a turn triggered by an inbound Telegram <channel> message ends WITHOUT calling the reply tool, hooks/stop-reply-guard.py blocks the stop and reminds Claude to resend via the reply MCP (once per turn). The command references $TG_HOOK (an absolute path the launcher sets via `tmux new-session -e TG_HOOK=...`) instead of a hardcoded path, so this committed file stays portable. Hook commands are shell-run so the env var expands. The plugin's own hooks/hooks.json is NOT used - --dangerously-load-development-channels loads only the channel/MCP part of a plugin, not its hooks (verified), so the hook must live here in the --settings override.
_comment_failover: The StopFailure hook reports a plan USAGE-LIMIT stall (error == rate_limit, i.e. HTTP 429) to the proxy. The proxy pauses that route and offers provider/model buttons in Telegram; after the operator chooses, it resumes the same Claude Code session through the selected route. It never switches providers automatically. Registered with NO matcher because the hook filters on the error field itself. Path comes from $TG_FAILOVER_HOOK (set by the proxy, forwarded by the launcher) to keep this committed file portable.
_comment_style: outputStyle Concise (built-in, landed in claude 2.1.237): lead with the result, skip preamble and narration, same thoroughness. Set here so topic-Claudes get it via the generated effective-settings.json; also set in the global settings.json for every other session.
